ViVu3D nationwide terrain colour

© ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium.
Source imagery: ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2 annual RGBNIR median composite, 2021, v200 (CC BY 4.0).
https://esa-worldcover.org/en/data-access
https://registry.opendata.aws/esa-worldcover-vito-composites/
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

ViVu3D averages groups of 2×2 observed pixels from the 8× reduced-resolution overview of the 10 m composite.
The red, green and blue reflectance bands are exposure-adjusted and encoded as sRGB WebP.
Each image covers one degree in WGS84 with 750 north-up rows. Pixels without a source observation are transparent.
The coverage follows the road atlas, including mapped islands. Each pixel represents a 2021 annual composite, about 137–148 m per side across Vietnam.
